title: Company
description: A tech company worth knowing about, organized by country. Deliberately separate from Link because companies need country/industry/hiring-status filtering.

country.description: Normalized country slug, e.g. pakistan, united-states, remote-friendly. Must exist in taxonomy/categories.yaml with type: companies, and must match the containing folder name.

industry.description: Free-form industry slug, e.g. fintech, saas, consulting. Intentionally NOT registered in the taxonomy.

date_added.description: ISO date. Must be quoted in YAML so it parses as a string, not a timestamp.

rating.description: Personal note on why this company is good or notable.
